verbal_intervention.source: Zacks via Yahoo Finance (Sep 15 15:02Z) / stockwirex CME 92.4% (Sep 16 ~02:50Z) / Newsquawk decision+SEP preview (Sep 16) / NBC News 'Trump, Federal Reserve on collision course' (Sep 16 01:00Z) / CNBC Warsh credibility carried - fresh
verbal_intervention.summary: Decision day opens with the odds band RE-FIRMED: yesterday's post-CPI easing tick (~78% cross-venue) has reversed to 90%+ (CME 92.4% print; Zacks 'odds rise to 90% ahead of Wednesday's decision'). The independence collision stands intact - a president's appointee voting to hike over the president's explicit objection into an SEP meeting, where the presser is read as the real signal. Volatility legs expected through 18:00Z decision.

verbal_intervention.headline: Trump reparations demands HARDEN + 'hopes for Hormuz deal fade' - payments would cover civilian demonstrator deaths AND US forces deaths; Tehran dismisses talks
verbal_intervention.source: CNA 'Hopes for Hormuz deal fade as Trump demands Iranian reparations' / The National 'Iran dismisses US talks as Strait of Hormuz crisis deepens' (Sep 15 08:31Z) / Iran Intl Truth Social 'world must reimburse US' (Sep 14 16:26Z) / India Today (Sep 14) - fresh follow-through
verbal_intervention.summary: The Sep 14 deal-pivot double-edge has tipped harder toward the escalation edge: Trump's compensation demands now explicitly cover deaths among civilian demonstrators AND US forces, while Tehran formally dismisses talks and CNA reads deal-hopes as fading. The negotiation channel exists but every named precondition (reparations, escort fees) adds material distance. Escalation-leaning verbal texture into FOMC day.

verbal_intervention.headline: NEW RUNG: Bessent confirms US participation in JOINT yen-buying intervention, calls it 'nominal,' says it supports American exports
verbal_intervention.source: Bloomberg (Sep 15) 'Bessent Says US Yen Intervention Was Nominal, Supports American Exports' / Nippon.com (Sep 16 02:01Z) 'U.S. Spent Nominal Amount in Joint Yen-Buying Intervention' - fresh
verbal_intervention.summary: US Treasury Secretary publicly confirmed American participation in the joint yen-buying intervention, characterizing the amount as 'nominal' and framing it as supportive of US exports. Extraordinary: a US Treasury Secretary openly confirming coordinated FX intervention while simultaneously pressing BOJ hikes - the sovereignty-stress marker on the yen thread gains an official US-participation leg one day before FOMC and two days before the BOJ decision.

verbal_intervention.headline: CARRIED THRESHOLD: record $99bn yen intervention confirmed UST-funded; Japan reserves BELOW $1 trillion first time in recent memory (~70% of reserves in USTs)
verbal_intervention.source: Bloomberg via Japan Times / Reuters / CryptoBriefing (Sep 7, carried) / biggo $79.6bn FX-reserve tumble (Sep 8, carried)
verbal_intervention.summary: Standing threshold remains the structural fact of the yen thread: official-sector UST selling is a live channel feeding US bond stress, and the intervention war-chest question is formally live with reserves under $1T. BOJ decision t-2 (Fri Sep 18) re-tests the chest; yen 155.294 flat on day 3 of the 155-handle, drifting through the decision window.

anonymous_leaks.headline: CARRIED: Reuters sources - BOJ set to lift rates Fri Sep 18 but offer few clues on terminal rate; poll: 1.25% this month, 1.75% reached faster than expected
anonymous_leaks.source: Reuters (Sep 9 sources piece + Sep 11 'few clues on terminal' piece, carried)
anonymous_leaks.summary: Sources-level confirmation the Sep 18 hike is locked with deliberate terminal-rate opacity - BOJ wants freedom to hike again without committing. The faster-than-expected path to 1.75% is the yen-carry-unwind vector: each rung drains the carry trade that has funded global risk assets. Now t-2 from the decision with JGBs at multi-decade highs.

anonymous_leaks.headline: CARRIED: Two regional officials - Petroline repair THREE-TO-FIVE WEEKS (AP); US Energy Secretary Wright counters pipeline 'in service soon'
anonymous_leaks.source: AP (Sep 14 ~07:47Z, two regional officials, carried) / Bloomberg-Newsquawk Wright 'soon' / TASS Wright Hormuz shipments (Sep 14, carried)
anonymous_leaks.summary: The Petroline two-track stands but the anonymous-officials timeline (3-5 weeks) is now OVERTAKEN by Friday's physical escalation: with the East-West pipeline shut AND Yanbu loadings suspended, the repair-timeline dispute matters less than the fact that both export routes are down simultaneously. Official-vs-official contradiction remains the signal texture.

anonymous_leaks.headline: NEW RUNG: Reuters shipping sources + traders - Yanbu loadings SUSPENDED; 'exportable crude exhausted within days'; EU late-Sep cargoes CANCELLED; inventories 5-7 DAYS
anonymous_leaks.source: Reuters shipping sources via Iran Intl (Sep 15 ~14:57Z) / OilPrice 'Aramco suspends Yanbu loadings' / Huawen Futures-Reuters 5-7-day inventory figure (Sep 16 00:55Z) / ET 'Saudi Arabia runs out of oil export routes' (Sep 16 01:50Z) - fresh
anonymous_leaks.summary: The anonymous-source cluster converged on the hardest signal of the window: with the East-West pipeline shut since Friday and Hormuz restricted, BOTH Saudi export routes are down simultaneously - Yanbu Red Sea loadings suspended per Reuters shipping sources, EU late-Sep cargoes cancelled, exportable crude 'exhausted within days' per traders, and tank inventories at 5-7 days per the tightest read. The US Energy Secretary's 'within days' restart guidance vs Goldman's 8-week outer bound brackets the uncertainty; physical cargoes print >$130/bbl vs ~108 futures.

central_bank_communication.headline: FOMC decision + SEP + dot plot TODAY 18:00Z - near-fully-priced 25bp hike to 3.75-4.00%; 'the press conference is the real signal'; nine hike dots expected
central_bank_communication.source: Newsquawk FOMC+SEP preview (Sep 16) / stockwirex 'press conference is the real signal' (Sep 16 02:48Z) / Continuum near-fully-priced (Sep 11, carried) / Reuters previews - fresh
central_bank_communication.summary: With the hike ~92% priced, the information content migrates to the SEP: first dot plot of the Warsh era with nine hike dots expected (none his own), plus the presser where any Warsh signal on terminal rate, oil pass-through, or independence lands. First hike since 2023 into a 5%-breach bond market and a 4-month-high Brent - the rate path itself is now a financial-stress variable.

central_bank_communication.headline: PBOC fix #6: 6.7628 vs expected 6.7148 - SIXTH consecutive strongest-since-Feb-2023 day; yuan SLIPPED despite the fix (demand weakness); Bloomberg frames strength track ahead of Trump-Xi ~Sep 24
central_bank_communication.source: Newsquawk fix print (Sep 16 01:15Z) / Bloomberg 'PBOC Strengthens Yuan Fix Ahead of Trump-Xi Summit' (Sep 15) / Daily Digest 'yuan slips despite strongest fix' (Sep 15) - fresh
central_bank_communication.summary: State defense continues: the fixing streak (6 consecutive strongest-since-Feb-2023 prints) is explicit state signaling ahead of the ~Sep 24 Trump-Xi meeting, but the market refuses to follow - onshore slipped despite the strongest fix, the demand-failure leg of the China thread visible in the fix-spot divergence. Strength is defense, not health; August retail miss + investment slump stand from the prior window.

central_bank_communication.headline: BOJ t-2: JGB 10y hit NEW 30-YEAR HIGH 3.035% (Jiji) + 30y 4.19% / 20y up across the curve; market near-prices second hike by year-end; 'market fears impact on yields'
central_bank_communication.source: Jiji via Nippon.com (Sep 15 17:21 JST) 'Key Long-Term Rate Hits New 30-Year High' / Phemex 30y 4.19% (Sep 16 00:12Z) / Herald Business (Sep 16 10:25 JST) / Nikkei Asia 'market fears impact on yields' - fresh
central_bank_communication.summary: Japan's bond market repriced into the BOJ decision window: 10y JGB at a fresh 30-year high of 3.035% (clarified: the 10-YEAR yield at a 30-year high, not the 30-year bond), 30y at 4.19%, gains extending on inflation concerns ahead of the Fed decision. Each rung higher in JGBs drains the carry trade funding global risk assets - the structural contagion vector, two days before the hike lands.

central_bank_communication.headline: CARRIED: ECB post-hike stress texture - FR-DE 92.85bp since-2012 wide, El-Erian 'Rome beats Paris', ING: spreads wider with Italy hardest hit, Kazaks 'growing case for more tightening'
central_bank_communication.source: ING Rates Spark spread exposures / money.it El-Erian (carried) / Reuters bond yields multi-year highs brace-for-ECB-cycle (Sep 10, carried)
central_bank_communication.summary: The euro-crisis stress texture stands: France pays more than Italy (since-2012 inversion), eurozone spreads wider with Italy hardest hit as oil-driven volatility meets hawkish ECB repricing, and Kazaks' second-day 'more tightening' follow-through holds the hawkish-cycle frame. ING's warning stands: retreating oil alone will not relieve the pressure if the ECB keeps hiking - and oil is not retreating (Brent 4-month high).

geopolitical_posture.headline: NEW RUNG: Houthis hold EFFECTIVE CONTROL of almost the entire western Red Sea coast (AP via Yemeni officials); Saudi issues FIRST-of-war wartime alert for MECCA; UNSC holds Bab el-Mandeb session; MBS-Sisi meet in Cairo
geopolitical_posture.source: AP via Yemeni officials (Sep 15, carried from 2037Z cycle) / Algemeiner wide-alerts piece (Sep 15) / Newswav 'first wartime alert for Mecca' (Sep 16) / Al Jazeera Bab el-Mandeb seizure analysis (Sep 13) - fresh corroboration
geopolitical_posture.summary: The territorial rung consolidated: Houthi control extends along the western Red Sea coast (consolidating Hanish/Perim), Saudi alerts widened to Mecca - the first of the war - alongside Jeddah and six cities, and the UNSC convened on Bab el-Mandeb while MBS sought Cairo alignment. A non-state actor holding both chokepoint approaches (Hormuz via Iranian posture, Mandeb via ground control) is the thread's structural escalation leg.

geopolitical_posture.headline: US posture: escorted Hormuz ops institutionalized - 660M barrels / 1,300 vessels since May (CentCom); Stars & Stripes: shipments RISING with US military assistance; claims-war with Iran continues
geopolitical_posture.source: Stars & Stripes (Sep 11) / CentCom 660M-barrel figure (Aug 21, carried) / CENTCOM naval-mine-claim rejection carried / gcaptain tanker-industry advisory - mixed vintage, standing
geopolitical_posture.summary: The US escort regime is the load-bearing wall of the counter-narrative: >10M bpd moving via the protected southern corridor, volumes guided higher by the Energy Secretary, with the tanker-industry advisory formalizing the transit protocol. Simultaneously the CENTCOM-Iran claims-war (naval-mine claim rejected) shows the strait's legal/optical architecture remains contested - volume flows, but under permanent naval supervision.

geopolitical_posture.headline: Iran dismisses US talks 'as Strait of Hormuz crisis deepens'; Salalah shelved stands with no new date; deal-hopes fade as reparations bar rises
geopolitical_posture.source: The National (Sep 15 08:31Z) / CNA / WaPo-Al Jazeera Salalah shelved (Sep 14, carried) / MBS-Sisi Cairo (Sep 15, carried) - fresh
geopolitical_posture.summary: Tehran's formal posture hardened the same day Washington's bar rose (reparations + escort fees), while the Salalah track stays formally shelved with no new date and Saudi seeks regional back-channels (MBS-Sisi). The diplomatic track is now a narrow, condition-stacked corridor - present enough to prevent total break, too narrow to resolve the strait question on any near timeline.

geopolitical_posture.headline: Trump-Xi ~Sep 24 frame + PBOC strength track: yuan defense is summit signaling; Trump trade-threat linkage ('cease trading unless Fed lowers rates') carried
geopolitical_posture.source: Bloomberg 'ahead of Trump-Xi summit' (Sep 15) / CNN trade-threat (Sep 4, carried) / Reuters Dolan (Sep 8, carried) - mixed vintage, standing
geopolitical_posture.summary: The China thread's geopolitical leg is a rendezvous, not a rupture: the PBOC's six-day strength streak is explicitly read as pre-summit positioning, while the US trade-threat-over-rates linkage keeps trade policy hostage to Fed policy - both legs feed the us_recession and china_collapse threads through a single collision node. Any Sep 24 rupture re-runs the 2018-19 escalation ladder with a weaker Chinese demand base.

supply_chain_disruption.headline: THRESHOLD RUNG: BOTH Saudi export routes DOWN - East-West pipeline shut (Friday) + Yanbu Red Sea loadings SUSPENDED (Reuters shipping sources); 'exportable crude exhausted within days'; EU cargoes cancelled; Al Jazeera: up to 5% of global supply affected
supply_chain_disruption.source: Reuters shipping sources via Iran Intl (Sep 15) / ET 'runs out of oil export routes' (Sep 16 01:50Z) / Al Jazeera East-West explainer 'up to 5%' (Sep 14) / Al-Monitor Europe crude scramble / Huawen Futures 5-7-day inventories (Sep 16 00:55Z) - fresh
supply_chain_disruption.summary: The physical-oil rung of the cycle: with the East-West pipeline shut since Friday's attack and Yanbu Red Sea loadings now suspended per Reuters shipping sources, Saudi Arabia - the world's swing exporter - has both export routes down simultaneously. Traders put exportable crude at 'days' (inventories 5-7 days per the tightest read), EU late-Sep cargoes are cancelled, Europe is scrambling for replacement barrels (Al-Monitor), and the Al Jazeera explainer frames the closure as affecting up to 5% of global supply. Physical cargoes print >$130/bbl against ~108 futures - the market pricing route-loss persistence.

supply_chain_disruption.headline: NEW RUNG: Libya NOC threatens FORCE MAJEURE - Petroleum Facilities Guards shut Hamada-Zawiya pipeline valve, 3 fields halt production; separate supply shock standing
supply_chain_disruption.source: Gate News NOC 3-fields (Sep 15 13:23Z) / Libya Observer NOC warning (Sep 15 19:56Z) / OilPrice (Sep 15) / SBS re-report (Sep 16 00:53Z) - fresh
supply_chain_disruption.summary: A second simultaneous supply shock opened: Libya's NOC warned of force majeure after PFG guards illegally closed the Hamada-Zawiya main pipeline valve, halting three fields, with the declaration still pending. Stacked on the Saudi dual-route outage, the marginal-balance math tightens materially - two OPEC producers disrupted at once for the first time in this window, with Brent settling at a 4-month high.

supply_chain_disruption.headline: Hormuz traffic sub-average streak stands (4 transits Monday vs 10 Sunday; third+ straight sub-average day) with TWO counter-narratives: two-way daylight VLCC transits resumed + escorted volume >10M bpd rising
supply_chain_disruption.source: Iran Intl 4-transit (Sep 15 02:50Z, carried) / Reuters traffic-dwindled (Sep 15, carried) / TankerTrackers daylight VLCC (carried) / Stars & Stripes shipments-rising (Sep 11, carried) - standing
supply_chain_disruption.summary: The strait stays bisected by narrative: transit COUNTS keep printing sub-average (four Monday vs ten Sunday) while escorted VOLUME holds >10M bpd and two-way daylight VLCCs run again. Both are true simultaneously - the escorted corridor works, and it is a war-supervised corridor. With Saudi's Red Sea route down, every remaining export barrel is squeezed through the escorted southern corridor or drawn from inventory.

supply_chain_disruption.headline: Europe crude scramble deepens + US diesel retail ATH $6.27/gal + Brent 108.75 settle (+2.9%, 4-month high; Oct print 109.29); physical >$130/bbl
supply_chain_disruption.source: Al-Monitor 'Yanbu halt deepens oil strain as Europe scrambles' / 2037Z board diesel ATH + Brent settle (carried) / nationthailand physical >$130 (Sep 16) - fresh + carried
supply_chain_disruption.summary: The demand-side transmission is visible at retail: US diesel at an all-time high $6.27/gal feeds directly into transport inflation, while Europe's importers race for replacement barrels with Saudi cargoes cancelled. Brent's 4-month-high settle at 108.75 with physical >$130 keeps the energy-red regime intact and is the direct oil-to-CPI channel the FOMC decision must absorb today.

regulatory_change.headline: NEW RUNG: US Senate procedural vote on CLARITY Act FAILS - BTC -5.3% to $74,910 (below $75k), ETH -8%, ~$300M liquidated in 20 min / $570-666M over 24h, crypto stocks plunge
regulatory_change.source: CoinDesk (Sep 16 04:07Z) / BingX $300M-20min (Sep 16 05:33Z) / CNBC TV18 carrying Bloomberg -5.3% to $74,910 (Sep 16) / COINOTAG $666M-24h / interactivecrypto (Sep 16 00:10Z) - fresh

regulatory_change.headline: CARRIED: US enforcement cluster on Iran oil financing - Operation Economic Outcast bank sanctions + $61M SDNY crypto forfeiture + OFAC indefinite suspension of three Iran general licenses
regulatory_change.summary: The enforcement cluster stands as the financial-war leg of the Iran track: bank sanctions, crypto-forfeiture on oil proceeds, and general-license suspensions compress every workaround channel Tehran might use while talks are dismissed. Regulatory pressure and kinetic posture are moving in the same direction - no de-escalation signal in the compliance layer.

regulatory_change.headline: CARRIED: Trump trade-threat linkage - 'cease trading with top partners unless Fed lowers rates'; Dolan: threat 'could be gift to Warsh'
regulatory_change.source: CNN Business (Sep 4, carried) / Reuters Mike Dolan commentary (Sep 8, carried)
regulatory_change.summary: The trade-rates linkage stands as a standing recession vector: the US president has publicly fused trade policy to Fed policy, threatening partner-country trade cessation unless rates fall - into a decision where the Fed looks set to hike. The threat raises tail risk on both the trade-war and independence-crisis channels simultaneously, and today's SEP lands in that context.

social_unrest.headline: Yemen displacement ESCALATION - 'Alarmed Yemenis flee south as Houthis keep up attacks' (Reuters); 3,400+ crossed to Djibouti in 48h (UNHCR/Al Jazeera); UN News: escalating conflict drives new displacement; 'hysterical panic' texture carried
social_unrest.source: Reuters (Sep 15) / UN News (Sep 15) / Al Jazeera Djibouti 3,400-in-48h (Sep 15) / UNHCR release (Sep 15) / NBC hysterical panic (carried) - fresh
social_unrest.summary: The humanitarian displacement curve steepened: new southward flight from the Houthi advance, 3,400+ arrivals in Djibouti in 48 hours with preparations for more, and UN confirmation that the escalation is driving new displacement waves on top of the ~94k IOM figure carried from the prior window. Civilian-flight acceleration is a leading indicator of the ground campaign's next phase toward the southern government strongholds.

social_unrest.headline: Saudi wartime alert footprint WIDENS - six cities incl MECCA (first of war) + Jeddah; Sanaa mock-drone display; civil-defence 'danger passed' line replaced by new alerts
social_unrest.source: Algemeiner-Reuters wide-alerts (Sep 15) / Newswav Mecca first-of-war (Sep 16) / AP Mecca alert + Yemeni officials (Sep 15, carried) - fresh
social_unrest.summary: The alert footprint's center of gravity moved: from energy-facility perimeters (Abha/Khamis/Jizan) to population and religious centers - Mecca's first wartime alert of the war is a threshold of its own, signaling that Saudi civil defence now treats the Houthi drone/missile threat as reaching the heart of the kingdom. The Sanaa mock-drone parade shows the deterrence-display loop running on both sides.

social_unrest.headline: Ebola texture CONFLICTED: Guardian 'outbreak has peaked, infection rates slow' (7,258/3,500+) vs UN News 'responders grapple with widening outbreak'; South Sudan presidential task force formed (prep)
social_unrest.source: Guardian (Sep 15) / UN News (Sep 15, carried) / Sudans Post task force (Sep 15 12:32Z, carried) / WHO AFRO - fresh + carried
social_unrest.summary: Both framings logged: DRC authorities read the Bundibugyo curve as peaked while UN field reporting describes responders grappling with a widening footprint, and South Sudan's new presidential Ebola task force is preparedness, not an outbreak declaration. Scored neutral 5x5 as last cycle; the peaked framing holds the upper hand but the cross-border-prep leg keeps the thread on the board.

financial_stress_precursors.headline: 10Y: 5% breached INTRADAY for 2nd straight day (Bisnow 'clears 5% ahead of Fed') but FADED to 4.996 close - above-5% CLOSE trigger UNTRIGGERED day 2; 'critical threshold' framing carried

Above-5% intraday twice with a hike decision hours away keeps the breach probability elevated; an above-5% CLOSE tonight (post-FOMC, post-SEP) remains the standing trigger for the us_recession stress ladder.

financial_stress_precursors.headline: CARRIED + EXTENDED: Fitch US private-credit default rate RECORD 6.3% (August) + Houlihan Lokey: defaults rising led by small companies and healthcare + Q3 spreads widen/standards tighten

financial_stress_precursors.summary: The private-credit stress leg stands with extension: record 6.3% defaults amid oil-spike refinancing pressure, distress concentrated in small companies and healthcare, and market-intelligence describing widening spreads and tightening standards. The invisible-corner default channel (private credit's opacity premium) keeps its position as the thread's slow-burn structural leg.

financial_stress_precursors.source: CoinDesk (Sep 16 04:07Z) / CNBC TV18-Bloomberg -5.3% to 74,910 (Sep 16) / COINOTAG 666M-24h / BingX 300M-20min (05:33Z) / live panel 75,663 low (04:45Z) - fresh

Funding near baseline and no venue stress signs keep this WATCH, but the $82k/$76k gauntlet frame from the prior cycle has resolved DOWNWARD into the Fed decision window.

financial_stress_precursors.headline: Yen 155-handle DAY 3 (155.294, flat pre-Fed) + JGB 30y 4.19% + 10y 3.035% 30-year high - carry-unwind vector into BOJ Fri; 155.20-155.x structural level flagged by market commentary
financial_stress_precursors.source: FXStreet (Sep 16 00:22Z) / Phemex 4.19% (Sep 16 00:12Z) / live panel 155.294 / ainvest 155.20-level piece (Sep 6, carried) - fresh
financial_stress_precursors.summary: The yen thread's market leg holds its threshold: third day on the 155-handle into a Fed hike (same-day) and BOJ hike (t-2), with JGBs repricing to multi-decade highs. The carry-unwind channel is armed by the policy calendar itself - if the Fed hikes while BOJ confirms and signals more, the differential compression accelerates into the weakest global-risk week of the quarter.

financial_stress_precursors.headline: Energy stress prints: Brent 108.75 settle +2.9% (4-month high), WTI 105.75, US diesel retail ATH $6.27/gal, physical crude >$130/bbl; gold 4,366.6 Asia bounce +1.0%
financial_stress_precursors.source: 2037Z board closes (carried) / nationthailand physical >$130 (Sep 16) / live panel gold 4,366.6 (04:45Z) - fresh + carried
financial_stress_precursors.summary: The energy complex is the inflation-transmission engine into today's FOMC: 4-month-high Brent settles, physical premia above $130 signal acute route scarcity, and retail diesel at an all-time high converts the chokepoint war into household prices within weeks. Gold's Asia bounce (+1.0% vs the overnight fade) shows the bid returning as the decision approaches.

financial_stress_precursors.headline: CALM WATCH TEXTURE (untagged): no fresh bank failures (FDIC 5 YTD), VIX 17.2 contained, SPX -0.45% orderly, money-market function normal; 'first bank collapse' pieces date-checked to May vintage and dismissed
financial_stress_precursors.source: 2037Z + 0437Z boards / FDIC YTD count (carried) / Infomarine piece dismissed (stale vintage) - standing
financial_stress_precursors.summary: The systemic-financial leg stays quiet and that is itself the read: equities are orderly, VIX 17.2 is elevated-but-contained, and no bank failures have landed despite the private-credit record. The stress ladder's rungs are in yields, energy, and crypto - not yet in funding markets. Any VIX regime change or bank event today would re-tag this finding upward immediately.

convergence.methodology: raw_score = sum(imminence x impact) over tagged findings; convergence_score = min(100, round(raw x 0.17) + 5x(categories_beyond_2)); >=100 ACTIVE, >=50 DEVELOPING, else WATCH (formal layer). Hand layer (0-200 composite, confirmed-state rule) maintained separately in blackwatch-macro-event.json and untouched by this scan. De-escalation ticks carry no thread tags (v2.1).
